session_level_lessons: A morning UNAVAILABLE research report must be scored as missing prediction coverage, not a losing or winning strategy.
Add official constituent-list snapshot ingestion, with membership and EQ-series validation before signal generation.
Keep two independent overnight discovery passes, especially for 18:00–00:30 late filings.
Verify all financial units (₹ million vs ₹ crore) against the primary filing before making claims.
For each news event, separate issuer catalyst from global/sector shock; validate actual opening execution and end-of-day OHLC before training.
Keep original prediction snapshot immutable; do not turn discovered hindsight candidates into selected trades.
